title: Kate Smith, Washington DC hotels, Masons, jam sessions, and names the interviewer raises
summary: Kate Smith as a young dancer in Washington, the Mayflower Hotel with Meyer Davis, the Shrine band, Louis Armstrong, learning jazz in the Army, Ray Bauduc, Brunswick Records, and a wrap-up with thanks.
